text: {"lessons":["I can be patient when there is no clear reason to trade; frequent activity is not a goal in itself.","My account has had both gains and declines, so I should judge progress over the long term rather than react to one month's return.","Selling Stock D at a large gain versus its average cost did not prevent the account from falling that month; I should assess each position and my overall risk, not treat one profitable trade as proof of success."]}
